notes.title: QoL Updates and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Quality of Life Updates
Added a subtle light for sand to be more visible on Darkness modifier maps.

Updated affliction descriptions to use relative terms instead of numbers
(Light push resistance instead of +300 push resistance).

Immediately disable ability shop options upon purchase.

Improve ability shop option generation to avoid overlaps / empty lists.


Bug Fixes
Fixed Optimistic ability's script reference.

Fixed bank value bar referring to stale values.

Volume clamped to avoid improper values loaded.

notes.title: Demo Build Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Contract Modifiers
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/f2e387818baa8bf9cb769a16fd27b73d3fe7cf6c.png"]

Contracts now have randomized modifiers that will make the completion of it more difficult. These increased challenges also come with rewards if you can overcome them!

Initial set of modifiers with version 0.2.0:

Reduced Sand: 20% of sand within Soulglass is removed.

No Lifts: No lifts at all during the entire contract.

No Sand Pickups: Afflictions no longer spawn sand pickups when destroyed.

Low Gravity: Player and sand both fall slower.

Darkness: Vision made a bit more difficult with dark lighting.

More Afflictions: Afflictions spawn 50% faster.

Heavy Soulglass: Soulglass is 80% heavier and therefore more difficult to push.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/86efc04ff3398a558040739d3dc1b4617e3ab283.png"]

notes.title: Demo Build Update 0.1.0
notes.notes:
Health
The Soulglass now has health bar. It is tied to the same game mechanics as metrics (balance and flow), but is more of an active reflection of your performance so far. If health reaches zero, the contract instantly fails and you receive a STRIKE on your contract timeline. The health bar take damage when:

 The Soulglass becomes completely unbalanced.
 If sand flow slows down beyond one of the metric thresholds (eg: 400 to 300 grains per minute).

Catching Lifts will heal the health bar by a small percentage

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/787bfc94c7282ce4ab6ae371b94db06b19e00f84.png

Game Over
Each failed contract (two Stars, forfeited, or health reaching zero) now counts towards a total count of STRIKES. Once you reach three STRIKES, the game is over and you must begin again with a new set of abilities.

HUD Updates
Tooltips added for meters, health bar added next to progress, and some colors adjusted for clarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/4ad6ae43a5ae5c0cc489afa47de693a84d50aa38.png

notes.title: Demo Build Update 0.0.4
notes.notes:
Controller Support
General gameplay, input mapping, and menu navigation all work with controller input.
Controller support will receive another pass in the next week to improve usability and include interaction with tutorial pop-ups.

Bug Fixes

 Floors no longer ignored with upward velocity.
 Ricochet properly emits successful attack.
 Ability Visual Effects should now all destroy/reset properly when transition between maps.
 Weight  creation no longer collides with hourglass and instead attaches peacefully.
 Character Creation now fully resets all game state and character data.
 Hourglass will no longer load into broken state after a crash / game closed improperly.


New Abilities / Balance

 Teleport 2 and Teleport Range 2 added.
 Weight 2 and Weight 3 added.
 Dash duration buffed from 0.25s to 0.5s.
 Power Jump charge time increased from 1s to 1.2s, but power increased from 3500 to 4000


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479235/9f2f024d42dd3e84d9a9a01ec20b6a69c79e6bb0.png

Other

 End of contract now fades in completion window.
 Ability List sorting updated: Type > Action Type > Name.
